description: Rename main Cursor chat to cstl task directory on select/start-execution
changelog:
**@blxzer/cursor-trellis 0.3.4**

- feat(cursor): auto-rename main Agent chat tab to task directory name after `task.py select` or `start-execution --approved` (`rename-session-for-task.py` + `cstl-session-rename.mdc`). Uses `cursor-app-control` `rename_chat` when available; silent skip when MCP missing. No rename on `task.py create`.
notes: Run `cstl update` to sync new hook, rule, and hooks.json wiring.
